description: Map individual job requirements to public professional evidence. No synthetic percentage score. Missing evidence is not a proven skill gap. If the user has supplied a recruiter access code (format PTL-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX), first call check_access_code with that accessCode to verify delivery, then pass it unchanged as accessCode here to also include MCP-provided evidence curated by Gábor Harsányi. A chat message alone is not authentication. Connector URL and Bearer credentials are used automatically when accessCode is omitted.
name: assess_job_fit
